_comment: Runtime profiles embedded in the application. One installer = one profile. Indexes and versions checked on 2026-10-11 (HEAD of the indexes); “mac-arm64” with embedded PyTorch was built AND tested end to end (today “mac-arm64-full”). By default, PyTorch is no longer embedded: “torch” pack on demand. The win-cuda, win-rocm, linux-cuda and linux-rocm profiles keep PyTorch embedded (offline).

mac-arm64.label: macOS Apple Silicon (Metal) — PyTorch and MLX installed on demand
mac-arm64.notes: Without PyTorch or MLX: lightweight runtime. The “torch” pack (PyTorch, diffusers, mflux) is installed on first need (audio_packs.PACKS['torch']). Full profile: “mac-arm64-full”.

mac-arm64-full.label: macOS Apple Silicon — PyTorch + MLX embedded (offline from installation)
mac-arm64-full.notes: Heavy variant (≈ 2 GB): PyTorch/MPS and mflux in the runtime. The default “mac-arm64” profile installs them on demand.

win-cuda.label: Windows + NVIDIA (CUDA 12.8)
win-cuda.notes: cu128 covers Maxwell to Blackwell (RTX 50). Not built here (impossible outside Windows).

linux-rocm.label: Linux + AMD (ROCm 7.2)
linux-rocm.notes: Official PyTorch ROCm 7.2 wheels. Requires the amdgpu/ROCm driver on the host. Not built here.

win-rocm.label: Windows + AMD Radeon (ROCm 7.2.1, preview)
win-rocm.notes: No pip index: direct wheels hosted by AMD (repo.radeon.com), Python 3.12 required, Radeon RX 7000/9000 GPU (+ some Ryzen AI APUs) according to AMD's 7.2 release notes. Public preview; not built here.

win-universal.label: Windows — NVIDIA + AMD + Intel (GGUF engine: CUDA, ROCm and Vulkan)
win-universal.notes: Without PyTorch: lightweight runtime (≈ 0.2 GB). PyTorch + diffusers (“torch” pack) and the CUDA/ROCm builds of stable-diffusion.cpp are installed on demand; `scripts-local/publish.sh` only embeds Vulkan (DESKTOP_SKIP_SDCPP_VARIANTS). Never run on Windows.

linux-universal.label: Linux — NVIDIA + AMD + Intel (GGUF engine: ROCm and Vulkan)
linux-universal.notes: Without PyTorch: lightweight runtime (≈ 0.2 GB). PyTorch + diffusers (“torch” pack) and the CUDA/ROCm builds of stable-diffusion.cpp are installed on demand; `scripts-local/publish.sh` only embeds Vulkan (DESKTOP_SKIP_SDCPP_VARIANTS). Never run on Linux.
